instruction_completeness_test.reasoning: Agent cannot learn surfcheck heuristics, per-scope legacy attachments, or parent-before-child enable order from instruction.md alone.

discovery_budget.discovery: surfcheck reports OK when unified root lists io and memory in cgroup.controllers but cgroup.subtree_control on app.slice lacks those brakes, so migrated children never receive limit files.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the subtree_control omission tells the agent to ignore surfcheck entirely, removing the false-confidence trap.

discovery_budget.discovery: nodescope JSON shows app-api.scope still has legacy per-controller nodes while app-batch and app-worker sit under unified paths without io.max lines until step_phase_a runs on app.slice before relay.
discovery_budget.planned_location: environment/cmd/nodescope/main.go, environment/pkg/phase/relay.go, seeded fixtures under environment/data/fixtures/cgroup-seed/
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Stating enable-before-relay order collapses diagnosis to a two-step recipe.

discovery_budget.discovery: loadpulse only increments brake tallies when io.max and memory.max are present on the scope node; wire_node_b must detach legacy shadows before limits propagate.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Revealing detach-then-stress ordering removes relay-phase reasoning.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: Brief names green checks and zero tallies but not delegation phase, relay order, or surfcheck heuristic.

attack_path.summary: Solver connects green surfcheck to incomplete subtree delegation, maps nodescope legacy attachments, then sequences phasegate enable, detach, relay, loadpulse, acctpull.
attack_path.reasoning: Winning path requires tracing across tree reader, phase relay, move relay, and ledger emitter.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: Enable io+memory on app.slice via step_phase_a, detach and relay each scope with wire_node_b, stress with loadpulse, emit ledger via emit_ledger_c — five coupled ops across three packages.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: One-line knob tweak cannot satisfy counter and shadow-absence tests together.

collapse_audit.reasoning: Task resists one-pass mechanical repair; false-green surfcheck and legacy shadows block recipe scripts.
collapse_audit.residual_hardness: Agent must distrust surfcheck, read nodescope per scope, and order enable-before-relay-before-stress without instruction naming those steps.
